newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ANA may not meet profit targets. [corrected 06:51 gmt]
newsitem.headline: ANA may not meet profit targets. [corrected 06:51 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects headline from "ANA sees 1996/97 net profit at 17 bln yen.")

Japan's All Nippon Airways (ANA) may not meet its forecast profit targets for the current financial year, a spokesman for ANA said on Friday. (Corrects by withdrawing profit forecast and changing ANA source)
"We are not sure we will meet our forecast targets," the spokesman said, adding "These 1996/97 targets were an operating profit of 18.5 billion yen and a net profit of 4.7 billion yen."
He said the airline's costs had increased due to the rise in oil prices this year. (Corrects by withdrawing earlier figure for rise in airline's costs.)
The correction follows a retraction by the company of an earlier profit forecast and various other data given by Nagahata.
"The figures announced by Mr Nagahata were in error," the ANA spokesman told Reuters.
